description: Reads the project's pages that are not live yet (its site, its landing pages: a draft never published, or a newer version of a live page waiting for its yes). Without version_id it lists them; with one, it reads that version whole from its own files: each page's title, description and its words in order (headings as #, list items as -, links as [words](address), pictures as ![alt](file), buttons and fields named, its regions such as [header] and [footer]), what the checks found, and its full-page pictures at a laptop's and a phone's width. A draft's address opens only from inside Marsell, so this is how you read it. Nothing is published: publishing is the owner's yes on the page's card (card_read, answer_decision). Each landing page with what making it again or changing it costs is pages_read.

pictures.description: true to get the pictures themselves as images beside the answer (Marsell's own pictures); otherwise their addresses, which you can open.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

version_id.description: One version to read whole, by its id from this tool's list or a card's pages. The list of drafts when left out.

name: site_draft_read
title: Read a page draft
